title: Brand Key
description: Stable brand identity used to resolve the canonical brand manifest, optionally scoped to one country market. The manifest URL is derived from domain; callers do not send brand assets or per-call brand overrides.

domain.description: Domain that hosts /.well-known/brand.json or is registered for the brand.

brand_id.description: Brand within a house-of-brands manifest. Omit for a single-brand domain.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country market for this brand identity (for example, NL). Omit when the identity is global or the house does not split the brand by market. This qualifies account and proposal identity; it is not a delivery-targeting instruction.
